messages:
maria: Heads-up: perf spike in prod for mistral-8x7b when seq_len > 1024. Latency jumps ~2x for tail requests.
kevin: seeing the same on canary. p50 is fine, p95 climbs. any quick profiler traces?
jun: I grabbed a short perf on gpu-45 using the new perf tracer:
jun: ```
TRACE: token_idx=1400, kernel_selector -> mha_fast (fallback to mha_generic)
TIMES: mha_fast=3.8ms, mha_generic=8.9ms, kv_store_write=0.7ms
NOTE: numeric detours at RoPE scale factor ~1.6
```
maria: interesting — kernel_selector flips to mha_fast for long windows? i'd expect custom kernel to help, not hurt.
kevin: yh. The flip is based on an heuristic combining seq_len and head_dim occupancy. Our threshold calc was tuned on llama-like RoPE. Mistral's RoPE scaling changes dynamic range and some fast kernels overflow/underflow -> fallback.
sarah: can you paste the exact selector log? ops-bot, show last selector decision for run 1865432?
ops-bot: @sarah selector_log: [run=1865432] decision=use_mha_fast reason=(seq=1400, head_dim=128, rope_scale=1.6) fallback=true fallback_reason=numerical_clamp
jun: also saw weird attention mask behavior: if request sets max_pos < true tokens we end up shifting masks, causing extra kv reads. Example: request had max_position_embeddings=1024 but actual context was 1400 -> runtime pads/truncates mask instead of sliding window.
maria: that explains extra KV churn. KV cache resize + repeated fallback triggers wallclock jitter. batching heuristics also send some long requests to same batch because we use seq_estimate not actual seq -> leads to mixed seq batches and kernel churn.
kevin: repro script attached (short):
kevin: ```python
# repro: simulate long chat with mismatched max_pos
ctx = list(range(1400))
resp = client.generate(ctx, max_position_embeddings=1024, model='mistral-8x7b')
```
kevin: profiler shows repeated cache evicts: `kv_evictions=3 per request`
sarah: actionable items?
maria: propose three small fixes: 1) tighten kernel_selector -> add rope_scale check and prefer generic_mha when rope_scale > 1.4 for 8x7b, 2) change batching heuristic to use declared seq length from request if provided, 3) guard KV resize path to avoid full-evict when max_pos mismatch (sliding-window shift instead).
jun: agree. Also add a quick perf flag to force_mha_generic for smoke testing.
kevin: will draft PR for selector patch and a test that runs seq=2048/rope=1.6 matrix.
sarah: can we ship hotfix to canary today? ops-bot, schedule canary deploy window 30m.
ops-bot: @sarah canary deploy scheduled at 2026-03-18T15:40:00Z (window 30m). :white_check_mark:
maria: i’ll instrument new metrics: kernel_flip_rate, kv_eviction_rate per model-version.
kevin: adding unit tests and a perf benchmark to eng-runtime CI (small 2-user multi-batch sim).
jun: note: follow-up — check head_dim mismatches for mixtral variants, some use 64 heads -> different occupancy threshold.
sarah: perfect. keep thread updated with before/after perf numbers. :thumbsup:
